thread:
maya: Heads up — vendor PortoData Consulting Lda sent INV-2026-219 for 18,500 EUR. They marked themselves as 'Foreign (non-US)' but did NOT attach a W-8. Invoice shows VAT PT123456789 and a 23% VAT line. Can finance/legal confirm documentation needs? @sam @owen

marta: :invoice: Invoice metadata: INV-2026-219, amount 18,500 EUR, invoice date 2026-05-08, bank details present, attachments: none.

owen: Vendor ops — please ask for a W-8BEN-E (company) and confirmation of service location. Withholding only applies if payment is US-source or services performed in the US. Regarding VAT: as a US buyer we typically are not VAT-liable; EU vendors usually zero-rate exports of services to non-EU B2B. Ask them to reissue without VAT or clearly state VAT 0% / export. I'll message them now.

sam: Legal here. If PortoData is an Lda entity, W-8BEN-E is correct (not W-8BEN). No automatic gross-up unless contract requires it. If vendor claims they must charge VAT, request the legal basis and documentation from their tax counsel — we don't have EU VAT registration so we cannot reclaim VAT.

priya: AP update: invoice put on hold in payment system. Note: "Awaiting W-8BEN-E and VAT clarification from PortoData. Do not schedule payment until resolved." I'll allow 72 hours for vendor response then escalate to tax/legal.

leo: Quick nuance — if services were physically performed in the US (contractor onsite), vendor might have US-source income and withholding could be relevant. Confirm where the work occurred (Portugal remote vs US onsite).

own: Sent vendor portal message + email at 2026-05-10T15:12Z with request: 1) confirm service location; 2) reissue invoice without VAT or indicate VAT 0% export; 3) provide completed W-8BEN-E. Copied AP.

maya: Do we ever accept EU VAT and reclaim? We don't have EU VAT registration AFAIK.

sam: Correct — without an EU VAT registration we can't reclaim. So ask them to remove VAT. If they insist, get legal basis and escalate. No Redwood gross-up unless the contract says so.

priya: Will update vendor ticket and set reminder: follow up in 48h if no response; escalate after 72h.

maya: Thanks. Action items: Owen to request reissue + W-8BEN-E (sent); Priya keep on hold and escalate after SLA; Sam on standby for disputes. :white_check_mark:
